title: Route to Trauma Bay 1
text: Route ambulance directly to Trauma Bay 1. Level 1 Surgical Trauma Team mobilized and standing by.

title: Cath Lab Suite 2 Prepared
text: Cath Lab Suite 2 is prepped. Interventional Cardiology team standing by in ED for direct transfer.

title: Code Stroke / Direct CT
text: Code Stroke team active. Transfer patient directly to CT Scanner 1 bed upon arrival for rapid imaging.

title: Pediatric Intake Bay 3
text: Ambulance Bay 3 is cleared. Pediatric resuscitation team and high-flow equipment standing by.

title: Request Updated Vitals
text: Hospital requests repeat blood pressure, pulse, and oxygen saturation measurement prior to arrival.

title: Hold at Bay Entrance
text: Please hold patient at ambulance entrance for secondary decontamination assessment.
